notes: Split of the locked 18-gene stress/UPR core into canonical PERK, IRE1, and ATF6 arms.
Genes are a subset of STRESS_CORE_v1. No gene is added from differential expression.
HSPA5/BiP is shared by the IRE1 and ATF6 short means because it is a shared UPR chaperone, not an arm-specific transcription factor.
These arm scores do not replace STRESS_CORE_v1 in the primary four-test family.

IRE1_ARM_v1.source: Canonical IRE1/ERN1-XBP1 arm plus BiP/HSPA5 inside STRESS_CORE_v1.

ATF6_ARM_v1.source: Canonical ATF6 arm plus BiP/HSPA5 and PDIA4 inside STRESS_CORE_v1.
